settings.title: Stick it. Score it. Win it.
settings.lede: Popdarts is a suction-cup dart game. Stick the target marker on a smooth surface, take turns throwing, and score the darts that stick closest.
settings.step_1_body: Choose a smooth surface — glass, a window or a countertop — and stick the Target Marker on it.
settings.step_2_body: Each player throws their 3 Popdarts at the marker. Darts that stick stay put.
settings.step_3_body: Use cancellation scoring like cornhole. First player to 21 wins — going over is allowed.
settings.points_3_label: On top of the PRO marker

settings.title: Questions, answered.
settings.lede: Still unsure? Our team is at support@popdartsgame.com.

settings.question: Which pack should I get?
settings.answer: Rookie Pack — our easiest Popdarts to land, great for kids and first-timers. Pro Pack — adds the PRO Target Marker™: land on top for 10 points. Elite Full Pack — our most advanced Popdarts, with a smaller Elite Target Marker™. Every pack is a complete game for two players.

settings.question: Where can I play?
settings.answer: Popdarts stick to smooth, flat surfaces — glass, windows and countertops — indoors or out. Rough or textured surfaces won't hold the suction cups.

settings.question: What comes in a pack?
settings.answer: Rookie and Pro Packs: 6 Popdarts (3 per player), a Target Marker™, a carrying bag with rules and a built-in ruler, and 2 stickers. Elite Full Pack: 6 Elite Popdarts (3 blue, 3 green), an Elite Target Marker™ and a carrying bag with rules and ruler.

settings.question: How does the sale work?
settings.answer: Sale prices are already applied to the products on this page — the price you see is the price you pay. The sale runs Oct 6–7 while each colorway is in stock.

settings.question: How do I clean the darts?
settings.answer: Rinse them with water or put them in the dishwasher.

settings.question: What about shipping and returns?
settings.answer: Shipping options and costs for your address are shown at checkout. See our Shipping Policy and Refund Policy.

settings.question: Do I need the app to play?
settings.answer: No — the Score Keeper app is an optional way to track scores.
